entities.summary: John Onuche Egbunu is a Nigerian professional basketball player for the Ulsan Hyundai Mobis Phoebus of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). Standing 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m), Egbunu plays the center position. In his first professional season, he played for the Long Island Nets in the NBA G League. He played center collegiately for the University of South Florida and the University of Florida.
